hook: Dry climates push river nitrate up worldwide, creating pollution hotspots far from farms and cities.
hook_turn: creating pollution hotspots far from farms and cities.

readout.label: People living where nitrate exceeds ecological limit

summary: Machine-learning maps covering about 2.9 million river segments show aridity raising nitrate across land uses. Concentrations exceed ecological thresholds on about 33% of land, and health thresholds on 2%. Because the maps are modeled rather than measured everywhere, local values may differ, and the aridity link is statistical.
title: Climate aridity amplifies global riverine nitrate beyond human inputs.
